text.tspan: Number of theft crimes in England and Wales
This data is based on the Crime in England and Wales Survey, which interviews adults face-to-face about their
experiences of selected crimes in the 12 months before the interview.
Data source: Office for National Statistics (2025)
Note: This data captures incidents that were not reported to the police. This makes it more comparable over time as it does not reflect changes
